What a week it was, thank you for tuning in #specialreport
Deadlines hit. Deals shifted. Pressure built. Here’s what shaped the week — and what to watch next.

Brian Moynihan shares that 27,000 people signed up for the “Golf With Us” program over the Maysers weekend, highlighted by Rory McIlroy donating his commercial fee to provide 80,000 rounds of golf for kids.
Tune in tonight to see my exclusive interview with Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan on @Fox News at 6PM ET. #specialreport #exclusiveinterview #bankofamerica
Check out the link in my bio and record your ‘Case for America’ today, the top 100 videos will receive a signed copy of my new book #caseforamerica #booktok #newbook
Supreme Court Justice Sonia Sotomayor has issued a public apology to Justice Brett Kavanaugh #specialreport
Saudi Arabia is reportedly winding down its finacial support for LIV Golf #breakingnews #livgolf
